WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT zoneref, articount FROM scanfeatures
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(articount) as total_sum FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    step1.zoneref,
    step1.articount,
    CAST(step1.articount AS REAL) / step2.total_sum as ratio
  FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2
  WHERE step2.total_sum IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3
)
SELECT 
  step3.zoneref,
  step3.articount,
  step3.ratio,
  step3.ratio - step4.avg_ratio as difference
FROM step3 CROSS JOIN step4
WHERE step4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
